build_contract: Both LLVM22.1.8 O2 jemalloc, same pinned source, only R32 finalizer delta
host: ChatGPT local Linux container, cgroup cpu.max=400000 100000, memory.max=4294967296; query max_threads=2; server memory limit=2850000000; query limit=1900000000
fixture: 250 builds/day x38 stages/build x14 days =133000 distinct one-sample series. RAW_UUID v11. Build-level project, branch and job labels. No physical table changes across phases.
query: avg by(stage)(avg_over_time(ci_duration{selector}[1d])) via prometheusQueryRange, 14 daily evaluation timestamps
protocol: stock/candidate/candidate/stock, fresh server each phase, 2 warmups plus4 measured requests per selector per phase. Full independent Python label/time/value oracle on every request; tolerance1e-10. QueryFinish records complete after asynchronous log polling.
limitations: Small sample count; fixed selector order; not a production SLA or VM comparison. Project apparent gain is smaller than control drift. R32 changes transient finalization allocation, not live aggregate-state map memory.
method_correction: Initial final stock phase missed asynchronous QueryFinish rows and was retained as invalid. Added bounded log polling and reran the entire final stock phase. No fabricated observations.
next_experiment: R34 initial sparse bucket-map capacity, isolated from R32, then native full 1.33m and dense negative controls.
